dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2018 general election. The City of Vancouver uses a Vote-Anywhere model. Since 2014, voters can vote at any voting place within the City.

The City operates an at-large voting system.

Note:

UBC and UEL residents are only eligible to vote for School Trustees.

Data currency

​​​​These are the voting places used for the City's 2018 municipal general election during Advance Voting and on General Voting Day.
